channel.title: Berri — Healthy Living Articles
channel.description: Berri's Nutrition Insights Articles explore micronutrients, gut health, food composition, and practical strategies for building healthier eating habits.

item.title: Nutrient Deficiencies: What Happens When Your Body Doesn't Get Enough?
item.description: Learn what a nutrient deficiency really means, why it develops, how it is identified, and why a few low-intake days do not automatically mean you're deficient.

item.title: Beyond Calories: Why Nutrient Density Matters More Than You Think
item.description: Calories tell you how much energy food provides. Nutrient density adds another important question: what vitamins, minerals, fibre and protein come with it?
